name: Polished Steel

light_interactions.under_warm_light: reflects amber highlight on silver surface; warm light bends and pools on the metal
light_interactions.under_cool_light: sharp blue-white reflections; the steel becomes a cold mirror
light_interactions.under_dim_light: faint gleam traces the surface; barely visible but catches any light source
light_interactions.specular_highlight: blinding point of reflected light, hard-edged and precise

prose_fragments: surgical precision in metal form
a mirror that gives nothing back but light itself
cold to the eye before you ever touch it

notes: High specularity. Almost perfect reflector in visible range.

name: Copper

light_interactions.under_warm_light: glows like a living thing — warm light on copper is almost too beautiful, all honey and fire
light_interactions.under_cool_light: the warmth fights the cool; copper goes salmon-pink, slightly alien
light_interactions.under_dim_light: a dull warm gleam, like embers banked for the night
light_interactions.specular_highlight: blazing orange-gold point of light, warm even as reflection

prose_fragments: warm metal that seems to generate its own light
the color of pennies and old church roofs
something ancient about its warmth — it was humanity's first metal

notes: Absorbs blue, reflects red/orange strongly. Tarnishes to green patina.

name: Gold

light_interactions.under_warm_light: incandescent — gold under warm light is almost overwhelming in its richness
light_interactions.under_cool_light: slightly greenish gold, still warm but cooler, more platinum-like
light_interactions.under_dim_light: deep warm gleam that seems to hold light longer than other metals
light_interactions.specular_highlight: blazing yellow-white point, warm and commanding

prose_fragments: wealth made material, light made solid
the warmth that never tarnishes
catching every photon and returning it richer

notes: Does not oxidize. Absorbs blue/violet, reflects everything else. Unique yellow reflectance.

name: Rusted Iron

light_interactions.under_warm_light: the rust comes alive — deep orange and brown, textural, almost edible
light_interactions.under_cool_light: rust goes dark and grim, more brown than orange, industrial decay
light_interactions.under_dim_light: dark mass with occasional glints where the original metal peeks through
light_interactions.specular_highlight: almost none — light is absorbed and scattered by the rough surface

prose_fragments: time eating metal in slow motion
the color of blood dried in sun
rough enough to catch on fabric, on skin, on memory

notes: Iron oxide (Fe2O3). Extremely rough surface scatters light diffusely.

name: Brushed Aluminum

light_interactions.under_warm_light: warm streaks along the brush direction; the lines become visible channels of golden light
light_interactions.under_cool_light: clean, modern, the brush lines catching blue-white in parallel tracks
light_interactions.under_dim_light: subtle directional sheen; you can tell which way the grain runs
light_interactions.specular_highlight: stretched into a line perpendicular to the brush direction, soft-edged

prose_fragments: the texture of modern design — precise imperfection
light sliding along invisible rails
cool and utilitarian, the metal of our era

notes: Anisotropic BRDF — highlight stretches perpendicular to brush direction.

name: Cotton Fabric

light_interactions.under_warm_light: absorbs the warmth and goes cream-gold; soft and inviting
light_interactions.under_cool_light: crisp white, clean, almost luminous
light_interactions.under_dim_light: pale ghost-shape, catching whatever light there is
light_interactions.specular_highlight: none — light scatters into the weave and disappears

prose_fragments: soft enough to see, the weave a whisper of texture
clean cotton glowing in the light like captured cloud
the simplest fabric, and somehow always right

notes: Highly diffuse. Subsurface scattering in fibers creates soft appearance.

name: Silk

light_interactions.under_warm_light: shimmers with warm highlights, the fabric seems to move even when still
light_interactions.under_cool_light: icy elegance; highlights go silver-blue on the folds
light_interactions.under_dim_light: subtle liquid gleam tracing every drape and fold
light_interactions.specular_highlight: broad, soft highlight that follows the drape — shifts as the fabric moves

prose_fragments: light sliding over silk like water over glass
every fold a new highlight, every shadow a deeper mystery
the fabric that invented the word 'lustrous'

notes: Triangular cross-section of silk fibers creates prism-like reflections.

name: Velvet

light_interactions.under_warm_light: the color deepens to near-black in folds; highlights show the true dye color
light_interactions.under_cool_light: cold velvet is almost funereal — the depth becomes a void
light_interactions.under_dim_light: absorbs light like a hole in the world; only edges and raised areas catch anything
light_interactions.specular_highlight: inverse of normal fabric — highlights on edges where nap is viewed from the side

prose_fragments: color so deep you could drown in it
light falls into velvet and doesn't come back
the fabric equivalent of a whisper — soft, absorbing, intimate

notes: Pile structure creates unique 'crushed' appearance. Lighter at edges (nap viewed obliquely).

name: Denim

light_interactions.under_warm_light: the blue warms to purple-tinged; faded areas go golden
light_interactions.under_cool_light: true indigo emerges — deep, rich, honest blue
light_interactions.under_dim_light: reads as near-black; only the lightest fades show
light_interactions.specular_highlight: slight sheen on worn areas; raw denim has almost none

prose_fragments: the blue of work and weekend alike
faded at the knees, dark at the hems — a map of how you move
twill diagonal visible if you look close, the DNA of the weave

notes: Indigo dye fades with wear, creating unique patterns. Warp-faced twill.

name: Leather

light_interactions.under_warm_light: leather and warm light were made for each other — rich, deep, inviting
light_interactions.under_cool_light: goes grey-brown, the warmth drained; still dignified but colder
light_interactions.under_dim_light: dark and present, grain visible in raking light
light_interactions.specular_highlight: soft, broad highlight on convex surfaces; sharper on worn/polished areas

prose_fragments: the smell is in the sight — you see leather and your nose fills in the rest
creased by use, softened by time, darkened by hands
warm to the eye, warm to the touch, warm to the memory

notes: Tanned animal hide. Develops patina with age. Oil content affects specularity.

name: Human Skin

light_interactions.under_warm_light: skin glows — subsurface scattering makes it luminous, warm, alive; everyone looks healthier
light_interactions.under_cool_light: pallor emerges; veins more visible; skin looks thinner, more fragile
light_interactions.under_dim_light: soft presence, warmth implied even when barely visible
light_interactions.specular_highlight: soft sheen on forehead, nose, cheekbones — the T-zone catches light

prose_fragments: the most complex surface the eye knows — translucent, alive, readable
light entering skin and scattering through blood below the surface
the one material we never stop studying

notes: Subsurface scattering through dermis. Blood gives warm undertone. Complex BSSRDF.

name: Oak Wood

light_interactions.under_warm_light: the grain comes alive in amber; knots become dark eyes; deeply inviting
light_interactions.under_cool_light: grain goes grey-brown; the warmth retreats but the solidity remains
light_interactions.under_dim_light: dark presence, grain visible only in raking light
light_interactions.specular_highlight: soft satin sheen if finished; raw oak absorbs everything

prose_fragments: centuries of growth rings visible in every cut
warm as a handshake, solid as a promise
the grain flowing like slow rivers frozen in amber

notes: Pronounced medullary rays in quartersawn cuts. Darkens with age and UV exposure.

name: Pine Wood

light_interactions.under_warm_light: goes golden-honey; knots darken to amber; feels like sunlight trapped in wood
light_interactions.under_cool_light: pale, almost bleached; the knots become the only warm element
light_interactions.under_dim_light: light colored even in shadow; knots as dark spots
light_interactions.specular_highlight: slight if sealed; raw pine is chalky matte

prose_fragments: the honest wood — knots and all, nothing hidden
smells of sawmills and new construction
pale and willing, taking whatever light you give it

notes: Softwood. Yellows significantly with age and UV. Resinous.

name: Natural Stone

light_interactions.under_warm_light: goes warm grey, almost brown; texture enhanced by raking light
light_interactions.under_cool_light: blue-grey, cold, mineral; the quintessential cold surface
light_interactions.under_dim_light: dark and formless unless texture catches raking light
light_interactions.specular_highlight: small bright points on crystal faces; overall matte

prose_fragments: the bones of the earth exposed
grey and patient, the material that outlasts everything
rough under the hand, cool to the touch, old as the rain

notes: Aggregate of minerals. Dry stone is diffuse; wet stone doubles in specularity.

name: White Marble

light_interactions.under_warm_light: glows from within like skin; warm light penetrates the surface and scatters back softened
light_interactions.under_cool_light: icy, pristine, the veins becoming blue-grey rivers in white ice
light_interactions.under_dim_light: faint luminosity — marble seems to hold light longer than it should
light_interactions.specular_highlight: soft, milky highlight; not mirror-sharp but broadly luminous

prose_fragments: stone that glows — light enters and comes back changed
the veins like frozen lightning, grey rivers in white stone
cool as water, luminous as moonlight

notes: Calcite crystals create subsurface scattering. Translucent up to ~1cm. Veins are mineral impurities.

name: Still Water

light_interactions.under_warm_light: perfect mirror of amber — the reflected world in warm duplicate
light_interactions.under_cool_light: dark mirror with cold highlights; depths appear bottomless
light_interactions.under_dim_light: black glass — reflects the faintest light with perfect fidelity
light_interactions.specular_highlight: perfect reflection of light source; sun becomes a blinding path on the water

prose_fragments: the world doubled, one version solid, one liquid
dark mirror that holds the sky upside down
still water keeping secrets just below the surface

notes: Fresnel reflection: ~2% at normal incidence, ~100% at grazing angle.

name: Moving Water

light_interactions.under_warm_light: shattered gold dancing on the surface; reflections fragmented and constantly reforming
light_interactions.under_cool_light: broken silver — each wavelet a tiny mirror at a different angle
light_interactions.under_dim_light: dark with occasional glints, the movement felt more than seen
light_interactions.specular_highlight: scattered into hundreds of dancing points — the glitter path

prose_fragments: light broken and reassembled a thousand times per second
the surface a conversation between wind and light
glitter and depth, never the same frame twice

notes: Wave surface fragments reflections. Sun creates 'glitter path' toward observer.

name: Ice

light_interactions.under_warm_light: warm light trapped inside, scattered by cracks and bubbles into amber veins
light_interactions.under_cool_light: pure blue-white, almost electric; the natural color of ice revealed
light_interactions.under_dim_light: faint glow where thinnest; dark blue-black where deep
light_interactions.specular_highlight: sharp on smooth ice; scattered by frost crystals

prose_fragments: frozen time made visible — bubbles trapped mid-rise
the blue of compressed cold, the color of winter's heart
hard as stone, clear as glass, cold as the idea of cold

notes: Absorbs red slightly → blue tint in thick ice. Internal scattering from bubbles and fractures.

name: Fresh Snow

light_interactions.under_warm_light: catches golden light and turns cream-pink; shadows go vivid blue
light_interactions.under_cool_light: blue-white diamond field; every crystal a tiny prism
light_interactions.under_dim_light: glows faintly, reflecting even starlight; never truly dark
light_interactions.specular_highlight: millions of tiny sparkles — individual crystal facets catching the sun

prose_fragments: the world's brightness dial turned to maximum
blue shadows on white — the coldest, cleanest palette
a trillion tiny mirrors scattered by nature's hand

notes: Albedo ~0.85. Individual crystals create sparkle in direct sun. Blue shadows from sky fill.

name: Green Leaves

light_interactions.under_warm_light: green deepens to emerald; warm highlights on waxy surfaces
light_interactions.under_cool_light: true green emerges; the chlorophyll sings
light_interactions.under_dim_light: dark, nearly black; green is the first color to vanish in low light
light_interactions.specular_highlight: waxy glint on smooth leaves; matte scatter on fuzzy ones

prose_fragments: chlorophyll in action, photons becoming sugar before your eyes
green upon green upon green, each leaf its own shade
backlit leaves glow like stained glass — the green of being alive

notes: Chlorophyll absorbs red+blue, reflects green. Strongly reflective in NIR. Translucent when backlit.

name: Tree Bark

light_interactions.under_warm_light: deep ridges fill with amber shadow; raised edges catch gold
light_interactions.under_cool_light: grey and austere; the bark reads as texture more than color
light_interactions.under_dim_light: almost invisible — merges with darkness; only the lightest bark stands out
light_interactions.specular_highlight: virtually none — every photon absorbed or scattered by the roughness

prose_fragments: a record of years in every crack and furrow
rough enough to write your story on
the tree's armor, weathered and ancient

notes: Extremely rough surface. Color varies enormously by species.

name: Clear Glass

light_interactions.under_warm_light: almost invisible; reveals itself through edge highlights and reflections
light_interactions.under_cool_light: ghost of a surface — faint reflections and slight green edge-color
light_interactions.under_dim_light: visible only by what it reflects; otherwise absent
light_interactions.specular_highlight: sharp reflection of light source; secondary reflections from back surface

prose_fragments: a surface defined by its absence — you see through it, not at it
only the edges betray it, glowing faint green
the architecture of transparency

notes: Fresnel reflection ~4% per surface. Faint green from iron impurity in standard glass.

name: Stained Glass

light_interactions.under_warm_light: from inside: warm light amplifies reds and golds; blues deepen to navy
light_interactions.under_cool_light: from outside looking in: the glass is a dark tapestry; from inside: cool colors sing
light_interactions.under_dim_light: dark jewels in lead frames; a promise of the light to come
light_interactions.specular_highlight: each piece catches light independently; the lead lines go dark between

prose_fragments: light made liquid and colored — the original cinema
each piece a jewel held in place by dark lead veins
when the sun hits it right, the whole room becomes the stained glass's painting

notes: Metal oxide colorants. Best viewed with light behind (transmissive). Medieval technology.

name: Frosted Glass

light_interactions.under_warm_light: glows warm from behind; a soft amber panel of diffused light
light_interactions.under_cool_light: cool milky glow; forms behind it reduced to soft shadows
light_interactions.under_dim_light: barely luminous; ghostly shapes beyond
light_interactions.specular_highlight: none — surface scatters everything into soft uniformity

prose_fragments: privacy made of light — you see brightness but not detail
shapes moving behind frosted glass like dreams half-remembered
the gentle scattering that turns a light source into a glow

notes: Surface roughened by etching or sandblasting. Scatters transmitted light.

name: Crystal

light_interactions.under_warm_light: warm light explodes into amber and gold fire; each facet a different angle of brilliance
light_interactions.under_cool_light: ice-fire — cold white with rainbow flashes; the purest sparkle
light_interactions.under_dim_light: dark until it catches even the smallest light, then: flash
light_interactions.specular_highlight: blinding points of light from each facet; rainbow dispersion at edges

prose_fragments: captured lightning, cut into geometry
every facet a tiny window throwing light in a different direction
the closest solid thing to pure light

notes: High refractive index (>1.5) creates strong reflections and dispersion (fire).

name: Concrete

light_interactions.under_warm_light: warm grey, almost brown; friendlier than expected for concrete
light_interactions.under_cool_light: cold, institutional grey; the material of infrastructure and indifference
light_interactions.under_dim_light: dark featureless mass; utilitarian even in shadow
light_interactions.specular_highlight: none — concrete drinks light without giving anything back

prose_fragments: the grey of cities, of parking garages, of the modern world's bones
rough and indifferent, the color of function over form
stained by weather and time, never quite clean

notes: Portland cement + aggregate. Highly porous, very diffuse reflector.

name: Asphalt (Dry)

light_interactions.under_warm_light: absorbs most light; slightly warm-dark; heat shimmer above in sun
light_interactions.under_cool_light: near-black, featureless; the darkest common urban surface
light_interactions.under_dim_light: void — absorbs everything; becomes the negative space between lights
light_interactions.specular_highlight: none — aggregate surface is too rough

prose_fragments: the dark ribbon of every road, absorbing light and heat
sun-baked and cracked, the earth's most common scar
dark enough to anchor the brightest streetlight to the ground

notes: Bitumen binder + aggregate. Very low albedo (~0.05-0.10).

name: Asphalt (Wet)

light_interactions.under_warm_light: becomes a dark mirror — amber reflections stretching into long streaks
light_interactions.under_cool_light: silver-blue streaks on black; every light source doubled in the wet surface
light_interactions.under_dim_light: black glass catching the faintest light and stretching it into ribbons
light_interactions.specular_highlight: elongated reflections of light sources, smeared by micro-texture

prose_fragments: the street becomes a dark mirror, doubling every light into wet streaks
slick and gleaming, the city's face reflected in its own roads
rain turns the asphalt from void to mirror

notes: Water film fills texture voids → dramatic increase in specularity. Classic noir surface.

name: Red Brick

light_interactions.under_warm_light: warm light makes brick sing — deep reds, warm oranges, the most welcoming wall
light_interactions.under_cool_light: brick goes dull, more brown than red; loses its warmth
light_interactions.under_dim_light: dark red-brown mass; the mortar lines become the only visible pattern
light_interactions.specular_highlight: none — too rough for any specular reflection

prose_fragments: the warm geometry of civilization — regular, strong, the color of earth fired
each brick a slightly different shade, the wall a mosaic of reds
old brick darkened by soot and rain, a city's autobiography

notes: Fired clay. Color from iron oxide content. Extremely durable.

name: Painted Wall (White)

light_interactions.under_warm_light: warm cream glow; the wall becomes a soft reflector of ambient warmth
light_interactions.under_cool_light: crisp blue-white; clinical and clean; the gallery wall
light_interactions.under_dim_light: pale rectangle in the dark; the brightest surface in any room
light_interactions.specular_highlight: slight sheen in gloss or semi-gloss; eggshell or matte has none

prose_fragments: the background to everything — the canvas before the painting
chameleon surface that takes whatever color the light gives it
clean and neutral, the absence of a statement

notes: TiO2 pigment in latex binder. Very high diffuse reflectance.

name: Brass

light_interactions.under_warm_light: burns gold — like gold's more accessible cousin
light_interactions.under_cool_light: goes slightly green-gold; the alloy reveals its zinc
light_interactions.under_dim_light: warm gleam even in darkness, holding light stubbornly
light_interactions.specular_highlight: broad warm highlight, softer than steel but brighter than copper

prose_fragments: the warm metal of doorknobs and instruments and old telescopes
not quite gold but gold-adjacent — warm, attainable, musical
tarnishes to a dignified green-brown with time and touch

notes: Copper-zinc alloy. Color between copper and gold. Tarnishes green.

name: Chrome

light_interactions.under_warm_light: perfect warm reflection — chrome becomes whatever it reflects
light_interactions.under_cool_light: cold mirror; the purest reflection surface made by humans
light_interactions.under_dim_light: even the smallest light source appears as a bright point
light_interactions.specular_highlight: perfect mirror reflection of the light source, undistorted

prose_fragments: a mirror in metal form — less surface than window into a reflected world
the cold perfection of industrial vanity
you see yourself before you see the chrome

notes: Chromium plating. Nearly perfect specular reflector in visible range.

name: Granite

light_interactions.under_warm_light: the feldspar crystals catch amber; mica flakes flash gold
light_interactions.under_cool_light: quartz crystals sparkle cold; the stone reads as elegant and permanent
light_interactions.under_dim_light: dark mass with occasional crystal glints
light_interactions.specular_highlight: polished granite has a soft, broad highlight; individual crystals may flash

prose_fragments: deep time made solid — each crystal formed miles underground
speckled and eternal, the countertop of geology
cold and permanent, the opposite of ephemeral

notes: Quartz + feldspar + mica. Polished granite is moderately specular.

name: Sand

light_interactions.under_warm_light: turns gold — sand and warm light is the color of desert mythology
light_interactions.under_cool_light: pale and bleached, almost lunar
light_interactions.under_dim_light: pale surface in darkness; footprints visible as shadow-lines
light_interactions.specular_highlight: millions of tiny quartz crystals sparkle individually in direct sun

prose_fragments: each grain a tiny quartz crystal, the beach a field of scattered diamonds in sun
warm underfoot, golden in the light, shifting with every step
the simplest surface — just earth ground fine by time

notes: Mostly quartz grains. Individual grains sparkle. Very high albedo for white sand.

name: Wet Mud

light_interactions.under_warm_light: dark and rich, like chocolate; slight gleam on the wet surface
light_interactions.under_cool_light: grim and cold; the grey-brown of bad weather and hard work
light_interactions.under_dim_light: near-black with occasional wet highlights
light_interactions.specular_highlight: broad, soft gleam where water pools on the surface

prose_fragments: the earth showing its dark, wet honesty
heavy and real, the opposite of abstract — you can smell it through your eyes
every footprint a small pool, every surface gleaming with honest wet earth

notes: Water-saturated soil. Dramatically darker than dry soil due to water absorption.

name: Ceramic Tile (Glazed)

light_interactions.under_warm_light: warm reflections skating across the glaze; grout lines go dark
light_interactions.under_cool_light: clinical perfection; the surface of kitchens and hospitals
light_interactions.under_dim_light: faint gleam on the glaze; grout lines create a dark grid
light_interactions.specular_highlight: sharp but small — each tile reflects independently; grout lines break the pattern

prose_fragments: the grid of civilization — clean, regular, washable
each tile a small glossy mirror; the grout lines a dark map
bathroom light on bathroom tile: the most honest mirror you'll face

notes: Glazed surface over fired clay. Very smooth, good specular reflector.

name: Wool

light_interactions.under_warm_light: absorbs warmth and radiates it back as cozy texture; deeply inviting
light_interactions.under_cool_light: still reads as warm — wool resists cool light's clinical effect
light_interactions.under_dim_light: soft mass, its texture more implied than visible
light_interactions.specular_highlight: almost none — fiber fuzz scatters everything

prose_fragments: warmth you can see — the visual texture of comfort
fuzzy and forgiving, catching light in its fibers and holding it
the look of winter evenings and reading by the fire

notes: Crimped fibers scatter light in all directions. Very matte appearance.

name: Linen

light_interactions.under_warm_light: natural cream deepens to gold; the slubs catch individual highlights
light_interactions.under_cool_light: crisp and clean; slight texture visible in the weave
light_interactions.under_dim_light: pale and soft; the natural fabric of summer twilight
light_interactions.specular_highlight: slight sheen from the smooth flax fibers, subtle but present

prose_fragments: the fabric of summer — crisp, breathable, naturally beautiful
slightly irregular weave that says handmade even when it's not
cool to the touch, warm to the eye

notes: Flax fibers. More regular than cotton, slight natural luster.

name: Glossy Plastic

light_interactions.under_warm_light: smooth warm highlight; color beneath stays true; cheap elegance
light_interactions.under_cool_light: sharp highlight; the artificiality fully revealed
light_interactions.under_dim_light: small points of reflected light; color goes dark but surface sheen remains
light_interactions.specular_highlight: bright, small, clearly defined — the signature of plastic

prose_fragments: the too-perfect surface of the modern age
color saturated beyond what nature offers, shiny beyond what it should be
smooth and impersonal as a product listing

notes: Dielectric material. White specular highlight regardless of surface color.

name: Flower Petal

light_interactions.under_warm_light: warm light makes red petals glow like embers; white ones go cream-gold
light_interactions.under_cool_light: blues and purples intensify; white petals go almost blue-white
light_interactions.under_dim_light: colors vanish; petals become pale shapes in the dark
light_interactions.specular_highlight: faint waxy sheen on some petals; roses have a subtle satin finish

prose_fragments: light passing through petals like stained glass — the color from within
fragile and brief, the most transient beautiful surface
each petal a tiny banner of evolutionary seduction

notes: Pigment cells + air gaps create complex reflectance. Many flowers reflect UV (invisible to us).

name: Wet Cobblestone

light_interactions.under_warm_light: reflects amber and gold in puddles between stones; stone faces deepen to near-black
light_interactions.under_cool_light: steely sheen; highlights go blue-white; stones appear darker and more uniform
light_interactions.under_dim_light: faint gleam traces the rounded tops; gaps become voids
light_interactions.specular_highlight: fragmented reflections of light sources in water film, broken across uneven surface

prose_fragments: slick stones catching light like scattered coins
each cobble wearing a cap of reflected sky
dark gaps between stones swallowing what light the wet surfaces throw back

notes: Wet modifier increases specular, darkens diffuse. Water fills gaps.

name: Puddle

light_interactions.under_warm_light: amber mirror on dark ground — a window into an inverted warm world
light_interactions.under_cool_light: silver disc reflecting the sky; a hole in the ground that shows the sky
light_interactions.under_dim_light: dark eye catching any stray light and holding it
light_interactions.specular_highlight: perfect reflection of light source, or scattered if wind-rippled

prose_fragments: the city's eye — sky trapped in a shallow wound in the pavement
step around or step through: a tiny decision about beauty versus practicality
rain's souvenir, holding the sky hostage at ground level

notes: Shallow water over dark surface. Near-perfect reflection at low angles.

name: Autumn Leaf

light_interactions.under_warm_light: fire colors amplified — the leaf becomes a tiny flame
light_interactions.under_cool_light: muted to brown; the magic fades under clinical light
light_interactions.under_dim_light: dark, indistinct; color gone; just a small dry shape
light_interactions.specular_highlight: faint waxy gleam on fresh-fallen; none on dry curled leaves

prose_fragments: chlorophyll retreating, revealing the hidden pigments underneath — the tree's last show
warm enough to heat your eyes
curling and papery, the sound of autumn given a color

notes: Carotenoids (yellow/orange) and anthocyanins (red) revealed as chlorophyll breaks down.

name: Window with Rain

light_interactions.under_warm_light: each droplet becomes a tiny warm lens; the world behind dissolved into amber bokeh
light_interactions.under_cool_light: cold droplets on cold glass; the outside world blurred and blue
light_interactions.under_dim_light: droplets catch distant lights and hold them as bright points; streaks glow faintly
light_interactions.specular_highlight: every droplet reflects independently; hundreds of tiny highlights

prose_fragments: the world softened by water — every light a smear, every edge dissolved
rain-beaded glass: each drop a tiny lens bending reality
watching rain on a window is watching abstraction happen in real time

notes: Each raindrop acts as a small convex lens. Total internal reflection inside drops.

name: Grass

light_interactions.under_warm_light: warm green trending golden; sun-drenched lawn in late afternoon
light_interactions.under_cool_light: vivid cool green; morning dew grass under overcast sky
light_interactions.under_dim_light: goes dark quickly; green is the first color lost in twilight
light_interactions.specular_highlight: tiny glints on individual blades in direct sun; dew amplifies this dramatically

prose_fragments: the green carpet of the living world
each blade a tiny solar panel, converting light to life
dew-tipped grass in morning sun: a field of tiny diamonds

notes: Strongly reflective in NIR. Appears to glow in near-infrared photography.

name: Moss

light_interactions.under_warm_light: emerald deepens to forest-dark; raking light reveals miniature topography
light_interactions.under_cool_light: vivid jewel-green; the truest green in the plant world
light_interactions.under_dim_light: dark presence, damp and ancient
light_interactions.specular_highlight: none — moss absorbs everything into its tiny forest

prose_fragments: a miniature forest for miniature things
green so deep it feels ancient, like it's been growing since before names
damp and velvet, the upholstery of the forest floor

notes: No vascular tissue — relies on moisture. Very diffuse reflector.

name: Candle Wax

light_interactions.under_warm_light: glows from within when close to flame; wax becomes luminous amber
light_interactions.under_cool_light: pale and slightly yellowish; waxy sheen visible
light_interactions.under_dim_light: near the flame: luminous translucency; away: pale shape
light_interactions.specular_highlight: soft, broad, waxy — the signature sheen of paraffin

prose_fragments: light passing through wax like light through skin — warm, alive, glowing
the drip-trails of past evenings frozen in cream
translucent enough to see the flame through, solid enough to hold it

notes: Subsurface scattering similar to skin. Beeswax yellower than paraffin.

name: Tatami Mat

light_interactions.under_warm_light: the straw glows golden, each woven reed catching light like individual threads of amber
light_interactions.under_cool_light: the green undertones emerge, tatami looking fresher, newer, almost alive
light_interactions.under_dim_light: a soft pale rectangle in the dark, its texture visible only as subtle shadow lines
light_interactions.specular_highlight: almost none — light is absorbed into the weave

prose_fragments: the smell of dried grass made visible
geometric calm — each mat a perfect rectangle of woven order
the floor that breathes

notes: Woven rush grass over rice straw core. Slight sheen along weave direction.

name: Rice Paper

light_interactions.under_warm_light: glows from within when backlit, fibers becoming visible like veins in a leaf
light_interactions.under_cool_light: crisp and clean, the translucency turning slightly blue
light_interactions.under_dim_light: a faint membrane of light, barely there, ghost-like
light_interactions.specular_highlight: none — the fibers scatter everything

prose_fragments: light passing through like a whisper through a wall
the boundary between rooms is a breath of paper
translucent enough to see shadows, opaque enough for privacy

notes: Translucent when backlit. Used in shoji screens. Diffuses light beautifully.

name: Ramen Steam

light_interactions.under_warm_light: the steam becomes a golden column, lit from the side like a tiny weather system
light_interactions.under_cool_light: white wisps curling upward, clinical and clean
light_interactions.under_dim_light: barely visible except as a softness in the air above the bowl
light_interactions.specular_highlight: none — but it catches and scatters every nearby light source

prose_fragments: the steam carries the promise before the first taste
a warm ghost rising from the bowl, fogging your glasses
you breathe the broth before you drink it

notes: Water vapor from hot broth. Makes light sources visible, carries aroma compounds.

name: Neon-Lit Puddle

light_interactions.under_warm_light: amber streaks across dark water, broken by every footstep
light_interactions.under_cool_light: a cold mirror on the ground, the sky beneath your feet
light_interactions.under_dim_light: the puddle holds more light than the air above it
light_interactions.specular_highlight: perfect inverted neon — the sign upside down in the street

prose_fragments: the whole city reflected in two inches of rainwater
step on the neon and it shatters, then reforms
a portal to an upside-down world made of colored light

notes: Thin water film on dark asphalt. Near-perfect specular reflection of neon sources.

name: Cherry Blossom Petals

light_interactions.under_warm_light: the petals glow pink-gold, translucent edges catching light like tiny stained glass
light_interactions.under_cool_light: almost white with the faintest blush, like skin in cold air
light_interactions.under_dim_light: pale shapes on dark ground, ghostly confetti
light_interactions.specular_highlight: faint sheen on fresh petals, lost as they dry

prose_fragments: beauty measured in days — each petal a countdown
the ground wearing spring like a blush
falling so slowly they seem to be choosing where to land

notes: Prunus serrulata. Translucent when backlit. Short-lived, browning within days.

name: Moss-Covered Stone

light_interactions.under_warm_light: the moss glows emerald where wet, the stone warm grey between
light_interactions.under_cool_light: dark and ancient-looking, the moss almost black-green
light_interactions.under_dim_light: the texture disappears into a dark mass, but the dampness catches what little light exists
light_interactions.specular_highlight: tiny water droplets on moss tips sparkle like scattered diamonds

prose_fragments: time measured in how thick the moss has grown
soft over hard, alive over dead — nature reclaiming
the stone remembers being bare; the moss doesn't care

notes: Composite surface. Moss absorbs light; stone reflects it. Wet moss is especially vivid.

name: Bamboo

light_interactions.under_warm_light: the segments glow alternately bright and shadowed, a natural rhythm of light
light_interactions.under_cool_light: greenish and fresh, the joints sharp-edged
light_interactions.under_dim_light: vertical lines of pale gleam, ghost-like columns
light_interactions.specular_highlight: a bright stripe along the curve of each culm

prose_fragments: the fastest architecture in nature — grass pretending to be wood
light climbs the segments like stairs
hollow strength, light weight, ancient utility

notes: Giant grass. Smooth outer surface with regular nodes. Green when fresh, golden when dry.

name: Rust

light_interactions.under_warm_light: rust comes alive under warm light — deep oranges and browns that look almost edible
light_interactions.under_cool_light: grim and industrial, the brown going dark and dead
light_interactions.under_dim_light: a dark rough surface, texture only visible at close range
light_interactions.specular_highlight: none — the surface eats light

prose_fragments: iron bleeding in slow motion
the color of neglect, of time winning
rough enough to feel with your eyes

notes: Iron oxide. Extremely rough, matte surface. Warm color palette.

name: Old Newspaper

light_interactions.under_warm_light: the yellowing intensifies, the paper looks even older, ink fading into amber
light_interactions.under_cool_light: the yellowing stands out starkly against what white remains
light_interactions.under_dim_light: text illegible, just a pale rectangle with dark patterns
light_interactions.specular_highlight: faint sheen where the paper is smoothest, between the printed lines

prose_fragments: yesterday's urgency turned to tomorrow's kindling
the ink fading like memory — headlines that once mattered
brittle enough to crumble, holding together out of habit

notes: Acid paper yellowing via lignin oxidation. Brittle with age.

name: Wax

light_interactions.under_warm_light: the wax glows from within — subsurface scattering turns it into a solid lantern
light_interactions.under_cool_light: pale and clinical, the translucency giving it an organ-like quality
light_interactions.under_dim_light: a faint pale mass, glowing slightly where light enters and scatters within
light_interactions.specular_highlight: soft, broad highlight that moves smoothly across the curved surface

prose_fragments: light enters and gets lost in there, wandering through the solid
the material of patience — drip by drip, layer by layer
warm to the touch of light, warm to the touch of skin

notes: Strong subsurface scattering. Light penetrates and diffuses within the material.

name: Porcelain

light_interactions.under_warm_light: warm reflections pool on the glaze, the white going cream and inviting
light_interactions.under_cool_light: clinical perfection — the white is absolute, the surface flawless
light_interactions.under_dim_light: a pale gleam in darkness, the glaze catching whatever light exists
light_interactions.specular_highlight: sharp, clean highlight that slides across the glazed surface

prose_fragments: civilization distilled into a teacup
so smooth it feels wet when it's dry
the sound it makes when you tap it tells you everything about its quality

notes: Kaolin clay fired to vitrification. Translucent at thin edges. Glass-like surface.

name: Cast Iron

light_interactions.under_warm_light: a dark mass that absorbs warmth — the slight oil sheen catches amber highlights
light_interactions.under_cool_light: brutal and utilitarian, the pitting visible as a landscape of tiny shadows
light_interactions.under_dim_light: nearly invisible, just a heaviness in the dark
light_interactions.specular_highlight: broad, dim — oil seasoning gives a satin sheen

prose_fragments: the weight of it tells you everything — this is serious cooking
seasoned by a thousand meals, each one adding a molecule to the story
black iron that holds heat like a grudge

notes: Cast iron with oil polymerization seasoning. Heavy, dark, excellent heat retention.

name: Driftwood

light_interactions.under_warm_light: the silver turns slightly warm, the grain becomes a landscape in miniature
light_interactions.under_cool_light: bone-white and smooth, like something from another era
light_interactions.under_dim_light: a pale shape, sculpture-like, the smoothness catching what little light there is
light_interactions.specular_highlight: very faint — the salt and sun have removed all sheen

prose_fragments: wood sanded smooth by salt and time
the color of everything after the ocean is done with it
sculpted by water into something no carpenter would attempt

notes: Salt-bleached, UV-degraded wood. Extremely smooth where water-worn, rough where broken.

name: Sea Glass

light_interactions.under_warm_light: the frosted surface glows with trapped warm light, amber pieces looking like solidified honey
light_interactions.under_cool_light: green and blue pieces come alive, cool light making them jewel-like
light_interactions.under_dim_light: faintly luminous, the frosted surface holding light longer than you'd expect
light_interactions.specular_highlight: none — the frosting scatters everything into a soft glow

prose_fragments: broken glass forgiven by the ocean
trash turned to treasure by salt and patience
hold it up to the light and it glows like a tiny window into the sea

notes: Mechanically frosted by sand and salt water. Edges rounded. Takes decades.

name: Cobweb

light_interactions.under_warm_light: each strand becomes a thread of gold, the web a miniature constellation
light_interactions.under_cool_light: silver threads catching light like fiber optics
light_interactions.under_dim_light: invisible until you walk into it
light_interactions.specular_highlight: each strand becomes a bright line when it catches the light at the right angle

prose_fragments: architecture made of patience and protein
visible only when the light is perfect — then suddenly everywhere
the work of something that was here before you and will be here after

notes: Spider silk. Nearly invisible except when catching light or coated in dew/dust.

name: Dust Motes

light_interactions.under_warm_light: each mote becomes a tiny ember drifting in a warm beam
light_interactions.under_cool_light: silver pinpoints dancing in a cold shaft of light
light_interactions.under_dim_light: invisible — dust only exists when light reveals it
light_interactions.specular_highlight: each mote IS the highlight — a point of scattered light

prose_fragments: the air made visible — every room is full of this, you just can't usually see it
tiny galaxies drifting through a beam of light
the slow dance of everything that's ever been shed, shed, shed

notes: Visible only in directional light beams. Mie scattering makes them bright points.

name: Cigarette Smoke

light_interactions.under_warm_light: the smoke turns amber and gold, each curl lit like a tiny weather system
light_interactions.under_cool_light: blue-grey ribbons floating in sterile air
light_interactions.under_dim_light: a faint haze that softens everything, visible only as reduced contrast
light_interactions.specular_highlight: none — but the smoke makes every light source visible as a beam

prose_fragments: a slow blue calligraphy written in the air and immediately erased
the smoke rises from the ashtray in a laminar thread, then breaks into turbulence — the transition is hypnotic
someone was here. The smoke says so even after they've gone.

notes: Sidestream smoke is blue (smaller particles). Exhaled smoke is white (larger, moisture-laden).

name: Breath in Cold Air

light_interactions.under_warm_light: each breath a small golden cloud that vanishes into cold
light_interactions.under_cool_light: white wisps in cold light, visible proof of being alive
light_interactions.under_dim_light: barely visible, a faint warmth in the dark air
light_interactions.specular_highlight: none — but backlit breath glows white

prose_fragments: your own private weather system, pulsing with each exhale
the cold makes your existence visible — every breath a small announcement
proof of warmth in a cold world

notes: Water vapor condensing in sub-10°C air. Brief, rhythmic, personal.

name: Blood

light_interactions.under_warm_light: impossibly red, vivid, the color screaming against any surface it touches
light_interactions.under_cool_light: darker, almost black, losing its redness to become something more ominous
light_interactions.under_dim_light: black and wet — you know what it is by how it catches light, not by color
light_interactions.specular_highlight: sharp wet gleam, the surface tension visible as a dark mirror

prose_fragments: the color that means stop, danger, alive, hurt
it darkens as it dries — bright emergency fading to brown memory
you notice it before you understand it

notes: Hemoglobin absorption. Fresh blood is bright red (oxygenated). Dries to brown-black.

name: Honey

light_interactions.under_warm_light: liquid gold — the honey becomes a lens of concentrated warmth, glowing amber-orange
light_interactions.under_cool_light: darker, more brown than gold, the sweetness less visible
light_interactions.under_dim_light: a dark gleam, the viscosity visible as slow-moving reflection
light_interactions.specular_highlight: slow-moving highlight that stretches as the honey flows

prose_fragments: time slowed down and given a color
light trapped in sweetness, thick enough to see through but barely
the speed at which honey moves is the speed at which good things happen

notes: High refractive index. Viscous flow. Color varies by floral source.
